final: SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost), AVG(avg_rate_per_day), AVG(avg_rate_per_day - overall_avg_rate_per_day) FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, AVG(AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)) OVER () AS overall_avg_rate_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) WHERE avg_rate_per_day > overall_avg_rate_per_day
